"},{"name":"gfm_rendered_link_detection","code":"import re

# Moderate interpretation: fail if the Markdown would contain a URL or
# render a hyperlink under GitHub-Flavored Markdown rules. This covers
# inline links/images, reference definitions, angle-bracket autolinks,
# GFM extended autolinks (http(s)://, www., emails), and raw HTML anchors.
# Bare domains without www/scheme (e.g. "brand.com") are NOT flagged,
# since GFM does not auto-link them.

_INLINE_LINK_RE = re.compile(r'!?\[([^\[\]]*)\]\(\s*([^)]*?)\s*\)')
_REF_DEF_RE = re.compile(r'^ {0,3}\[[^\]]+\]:[ \t]*<?\S+>?', re.MULTILINE)
_ANGLE_AUTOLINK_RE = re.compile(
    r'<(?:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]{1,31}:[^\s<>]*|[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})>'
)
_EXT_URL_RE = re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9])(?:https?|ftp)://[^\s<]+', re.IGNORECASE)
_EXT_WWW_RE = re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9])www\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)+', re.IGNORECASE)
_EXT_EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r'\b[A-Za-z0-9._+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)*\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b')
_HTML_ANCHOR_RE = re.compile(r'<a\b[^>]*\bhref\s*=', re.IGNORECASE)
_MAILTO_RE = re.compile(r'\bmailto:\S+', re.IGNORECASE)


def _strip_code(text: str) -> str:
    # Remove fenced and inline code so literal examples inside code are
    # not treated as rendered links (they'd still be visible text, but
    # code spans aren't hyperlinks). URLs inside code are still checked
    # separately below via the extended URL patterns on the original text.
    text = re.sub(r'```.*?```', ' ', text, flags=re.DOTALL)
    text = re.sub(r'`[^`]*`', ' ', text)
    return text


def evaluate(output: str, inputs: dict) -> bool:
    if not output:
        return True

    # Raw URLs anywhere (even in code) count as URLs.
    if _EXT_URL_RE.search(output) or _EXT_WWW_RE.search(output) or _MAILTO_RE.search(output):
        return False

    text = _strip_code(output)

    for m in _INLINE_LINK_RE.finditer(text):
        target = m.group(2).strip()
        if target:
            return False

    if _REF_DEF_RE.search(text):
        return False
    if _ANGLE_AUTOLINK_RE.search(text):
        return False
    if _EXT_EMAIL_RE.search(text):
        return False
    if _HTML_ANCHOR_RE.search(text):
        return False

    return True

# Loose interpretation: only fail on unambiguous, explicit links:
#  - URLs with a web scheme (http://, https://, ftp://)
#  - www.-prefixed web addresses
#  - Markdown inline links [text](target) whose target looks like a URL/path
#  - HTML anchor tags with href
# Brand names that merely include a domain ("Amazon.com"), email addresses,
# and bracketed text without a link target are tolerated.

_SCHEME_RE = re.compile(r'\b(?:https?|ftp)://[^\s)>\]]+', re.IGNORECASE)
_WWW_RE = re.compile(r'\bwww\.[a-z0-9-]+\.[a-z]{2,}', re.IGNORECASE)
_MD_LINK_RE = re.compile(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(\s*([^)\s]+)[^)]*\)')
_HTML_A_RE = re.compile(r'<a\s+[^>]*href\s*=', re.IGNORECASE)


def _looks_like_link_target(target: str) -> bool:
    t = target.strip().strip('<>').lower()
    if not t:
        return False
    if re.match(r'^(?:[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*:|//|/|#|\./|\.\./|www\.)', t):
        return True
    # something like example.com/path or shop.example.org
    if re.match(r'^[a-z0-9-]+(?:\.[a-z0-9-]+)+(?:/\S*)?$', t):
        return True
    return False


def evaluate(output: str, inputs: dict) -> bool:
    if not output:
        return True
    if _SCHEME_RE.search(output):
        return False
    if _WWW_RE.search(output):
        return False
    if _HTML_A_RE.search(output):
        return False
    for m in _MD_LINK_RE.finditer(output):
        if _looks_like_link_target(m.group(1)):
            return False
    return True
